Dolly Waggon, Keswick - B&B Guest House with Great Views
Delightful Guest House in the heart of Keswick
An Adults-Only Victorian Guest House in the Heart of Keswick.
Welcome to Dolly Waggon, Keswick
Discover quality bed and breakfast accommodation in the heart of Keswick, Lake District. Named after one of the fells in the Helvellyn range, our Victorian guesthouse - a distinctive red brick building dating back to circa 1900 - provides the perfect base for exploring this beautiful region.
Your Home Away from Home
Set in a quiet residential location with fell views from every guest bedroom, Dolly Waggon is just a short, flat walk from Keswick town centre, the shores of Derwentwater, and the Theatre by the Lake. Whether you're exploring on foot, by bike, or by bus, you'll find yourself ideally positioned to discover the best of Keswick and the Lake District's charming towns and villages.
We offer five ensuite rooms to suit all guests: one single, two doubles, and two superking/twin rooms—all featuring full central heating, double glazing, flat-screen TVs, hairdryers, and hospitality trays.
A Warm Welcome Awaits
As a family-run, adult-only guesthouse, we're committed to ensuring every guest enjoys a memorable stay. We begin each day with a delicious, hearty breakfast featuring locally sourced produce, and we're happy to accommodate special dietary requirements (just let us know when you book).
Complimentary Wi-Fi is available throughout the guesthouse, keeping you connected during your visit.
*Please note: We are a non-smoking establishment and do not accommodate pets.
Keswick
As a very popular tourist town, Keswick possibly has as many places to eat and drink as it has to visit and shop. Walk out the door of Dolly Waggon and in just a few streets you have reached the bustling town centre but, if it’s peace and quiet you yearn for then travel on foot, by bike or car in any direction and peace and quiet you will quickly find.
No car? No problem! There is a good bus service from Keswick to all the most popular places, including an open-top bus sightseeing through either Borrowdale (simply amazing) or south to Grasmere (just beautiful).
There are some fantastic walks and bike rides directly from the guest house as well and we will gladly offer you advice and maps for your trip.
Ensuite bed and breakfast Keswick
Spacious rooms with private bathrooms, mountain views, and carpeted floors. Each room includes WiFi, a TV, electric kettle, and free toiletries.
Rooms - Learn More
Walkers accommodation in Keswick
Whether you choose to walk, cycle, drive or use public transport you are never far from something interesting when you stay in Keswick.
Things to do
Breakfast at Dolly Waggon
Guest houses are often referred to as Bed & Breakfast for a reason so we think it naturally follows that after a good nights sleep, in preparation for a busy day in the Lake District, you should start your day with one of our wonderful breakfasts.
Where possible we use local, organic and fair trade products and, if you need us to, can cater for individual dietary needs. We have all the usual culprits so you can begin with juice, cereal or yoghurt and follow on with our generous full English breakfast.
Vegetarian breakfasts and lighter alternatives are also available, such as scrambled or poached eggs on toast, or smoked salmon and scrambled egg on a toasted muffin. Of course whatever your choice there’s always bread, toasted just how you like it, and locally made preserves to round off a breakfast that will prepare you for the day ahead.
About Us
We are a family run guest house, and moved here in April 21, from Coventry. We’ve been visiting the Lakes, especially Keswick, for 15 years, and always wanted to live here. We enjoy meeting a variety of guests, be they walkers, cyclists, sightseers, or just passing through the town. Everyone has a different story.
We enjoy walking, and have recently decided to try and walk all of the 214 Wainwright’s, we’ve walked many of them previously, but now we have the book we need to do them all again!!

Accommodation - Dolly Waggon Keswick
Dolly Waggon Accommodation
We have a choice of accommodation, one single room, two double rooms, and two flexible rooms that can be made as either twin or doubles. All rooms are en-suite, have individually controlled central heating, and have been updated with modern furnishings.
Guests have their own keys and can access their rooms throughout the day. Guest information packs are provided in each room, providing information about your stay and ideas of places to visit.
Cleanliness and comfort are priorities and we operate a full no-smoking policy within the house.
We're just a very short walk into town with all its amenities, shops, eateries and places to visit.

About - Dolly Waggon, Keswick
About Dolly Waggon & FAQ's
How to find us. FAQ's. Get in touch
FAQ's
What time is check-in and check-out?
The earliest check-in time is 4:00pm, the latest is 9:00pm. We kindly request that you check out by 10:00am.
What payment methods do you accept?
Cheque, Cash, Visa, Mastercard or Bank transfer
How long does it take to walk into town from Dolly Waggon Guest House?
To walk into town takes just a few minutes, it's about 3 streets away.
Do we accept pets?
Unfortunately we do not accept pets.
Do we accept children?
Unfortunately we do NOT accept children under 16.
What are the terms and conditions of booking?
We have Terms & Conditions available here.
Contact Dolly Waggon
We'd love to hear from you! Whether you have questions about our rooms, local attractions, or need assistance with your booking, please don't hesitate to reach out. Email or call and we'll get back to you as soon as possible.
Here's the contact details:
Dolly Waggon Guest House, Helvellyn Street, Keswick, Cumbria, CA12 4EN
Email:
Phone: 017687 73593
For the quickest response, please call us during business hours.
Our Location on the Map
Getting here
From the M6 motorway, the best approach to Keswick is via the A66 from Penrith leading to the A591 Penrith Rd. From the exit of the A66 keep left at the bottom, then at the next junction turn right. As you enter Keswick, the River Greta is on your right hand side. As you near the town, there is a long green slate wall flanking the river. Keep your eyes open for a pelican crossing and turn left immediately in front of it – it’s a sharp left, into Southey Street. Drive up Southey Street a little way and take the 3rd left – this is Helvellyn Street and we are located about 500 yards down on the left hand side.
